name: AMP53
description: "A control / power amplifier developed with a design philosophy of ""keeping the signal path as short as possible"".Digital Intelligent Gain Management (DIGM), an original volume control technology, is adopted.This volume controls the gain of the amplifier by switching the metal film register using a class A switch using a bipolar transistor without reducing the level of the input signal, and improves the quality of the amplifier by digitally controlling the gain of the amplifier.There are 66 levels of volume control for each 1 dB.In addition, the digital balance adjustment function is realized by using the DIGM function, and the left / right balance adjustment can be adjusted up to + 10 dB in increments of 1 dB.It employs a new-generation LEF circuit (Load Effect Free) originally developed by CEC, and consists of a pure A-class single-ended amplifier.All circuits from the input stage to the output stage are designed to be fully balanced. In addition, the left and right music signals are processed by independent circuits to reduce interference between the circuits.To adjust the volume levels of the sources with different output levels, it is possible to increase the gain by 6 dB for each input channel.Eight 15A power transistors are used to maintain high power even for complex loads.The power supply employs a 90,000 Ï‰ F capacitor and a 300W toroidal transformer coupled with a new LEF circuit.Aluminum extrusion is used for the case and volume knob to improve cooling effect as well as high stability.In addition, the heat sink located just under the top cover is integrated with the chassis, and air drawn from the top back passes through the heat sink while cooling it and is discharged from the bottom center by the fan.Equipped with an internal temperature control system, the sensor senses the internal temperature of the amplifier, and automatically controls the air flow in the cooling unit to maintain the appropriate internal temperature.Volume, input switching, amplifier internal temperature, etc. are displayed on two VFD displays."

name: AMP71
description: "A controlled power amplifier equipped with LEF developed by Carlos Kandyas.The AMP71 employs a single-ended circuit in which a single transistor processes all the music signals. Unlike many other amplifiers, the AMP71 does not split the music signal by half a wavelength into the + and - sides. It also eliminates the dynamic range variation that occurs when transistors are arranged for each + - polarity.In addition, by installing a unique LEF circuit, high-efficiency high-power with less heat generation is realized even though it is pure A class.Since stable amplification with good linearity is possible by the LEF circuit, basically no NFB loop is required, and a straight and shortest signal path is realized by a completely non-feedback amplifier.With a unique differential and full balance circuit design, the music signal is processed in a completely separate state from the input terminal to all areas of the volume control and power amplifier, and even to the speaker terminal.In addition, it has a fully dual-monaural configuration, and with the exception of the AC power inlet, the power supply circuit with a 650 VA toroidal transformer is completely symmetrical from the input terminal to the speaker terminal.The protection circuit is equipped with a monitoring circuit equipped with a high-speed protector that eliminates mechanical contact, and checks current, voltage, DC, offset, power supply circuit, etc.The volume control mechanism uses a 100-step thin-film resistor with a high-precision single FET for switching between steps.As a result, the channel balance is completely uniform on the right and left, and stability without change over time is obtained.In addition to two balanced and four unbalanced inputs, there is an RCA tape output.All input signals are switched by a pulse control relay located at the optimum position on the board."

name: TL51XZ
description: "A CD player using belt drive system.A belt drive mechanism unique to CEC is adopted for the mechanism part.In this system, by separating the spindle motor, which rotates the disk, from the mechanism chassis, vibration and electromagnetic noise generated by the motor itself are absorbed and blocked from the root.In addition, the pickup unit is placed in the center of the housing and a special anti-vibration material is attached to the lower chassis to absorb and block the sound pressure from the speaker and micro vibration from inside and outside.By using a 300 gram weight class stabilizer in the innermost part, warping and vibration of the disc during performance are minimized.In addition, by effectively utilizing the moment of inertia of the stabilizer via the belt to the low-torque spindle motor, we have achieved stabilization of angular velocity without being affected by motor current fluctuations and servo errors by taking advantage of our own flywheel effect, which enables quieter and smoother rotation than ordinary CD players.For the D/A conversion part, SM5865CM made by NPC Co. corresponding to 24bit/192kHz is adopted.In addition, a 0. 3nsec ultra-high-speed memory device is installed at the input of the DAC circuit to enable ultra-high-speed digital transmission with virtually no jitter. In addition, a linear flat filter is used to eliminate ringing distortion that occurs in a pulsatile waveform, thereby realizing sound quality without digital smell.In addition, the IV converter is a passive type, and the analog section is a fully balanced non-feedback circuit, realizing single-end pure class A operation.Each stage of the power supply section is equipped with a large power supply equipped with a power supply enhancer, providing a quiet and stable power supply. Especially around the DAC, the digital and analog sections are completely separated.We have also adopted our own time-constant amplifier, whose supply speed is not affected by the performance of transformers and capacitors, to reduce noise level and increase speed.In addition to coaxial and optical digital outputs, AES/EBU (XLR) and CEC superlink are incorporated.The CEC Superlink can transmit audio and clock data separately without passing through SPDIF encoding, thereby minimizing degradation of sound quality.Wireless remote control is included."

name: TL5100Z
description: "This CD player uses a CD belt drive mechanism to satisfy the requirements of stable disk rotation accuracy and no vibration and resonance.By adopting the belt drive system, dense signal pickup capability is obtained.The input part of the DAC circuit has a built-in DDS circuit that enables virtually jitter-free high-speed transmission.This circuit uses a new memory device that enables high-speed operation of 0.3n seconds for waveform formation of digital signals consisting of short waves. name: TL1
description: "CD transport using belt drive system.The mechanism uses a belt drive system.In conventional CD players, in order to reproduce a signal recorded on a CD at a constant linear velocity, the rotational speed of the disc from the inner circumference to the outer circumference is changed from approximately 500 rpm to approximately 200 rpm, and further control is performed to keep the linear velocity constant due to the eccentricity component. However, in order to finely change the angular velocity of a rotating body with a large inertia, a large acceleration is required, and this causes the entire body to fluctuate, resulting in vibration, which affects the reproduction effect of the CD.In the belt drive system, not only the pickup feed mechanism but also the disk rotation system is equipped with a special belt whose durability has been verified through severe reliability tests. This belt absorbs and blocks vibration and noise from the motor. In addition, a low-torque motor with greatly reduced cogging is used as the drive motor. This reduces electromagnetic noise generated by driving the high-torque motor at high current.A stabilizer system is used to secure the disc.The large stabilizer ensures that the disc is centered and held securely, and the large design (120 mm, 370g) matched to the outer diameter of the disc provides a large moment of inertia 26 times larger than that of the disc.¥4 mm bearing is used for the shaft bearing.These bearings are made of carefully selected materials using ultra-precision machining technology developed through analog players.The servo circuit uses a unique method.In the TL1, in order to maintain the wheel effect of the large stabilizer while making effective use of it, time information is obtained by the subcode, and it functions to give appropriate torque to the motor. In addition, appropriate torque is given at the start of rotation and at the time of access. Furthermore, the linear velocity change due to the eccentricity component of one rotation or less is all handled by the PLL servo.The main chassis is made of 2 mm thick steel plate and the enclosure is made of extruded aluminum up to 8 mm thick. The main chassis and the enclosure are equipped with damper seats to effectively suppress vibration and resonance, thereby eliminating not only vibrations from internal mechanisms but also adverse effects from external vibrations and sound pressure.In addition, the strut supporting the mechanism is composed of cushion rubber and coil spring, and high damping characteristics are obtained.Wireless remote control is included."

name: TL1X
description: "Belt-drive-type CD transport with a unique vibration control mechanism and further improved perfection.In the past, the mechanism chassis was floated with a suspension composed of cushion rubber and coil spring. However, it integrating it with cushion rubber and making the material more flexible, damping characteristics have been improved.In addition, the drive motor fixed to the base chassis of the housing is used as a belt drive to separate the mechanism from the drive part, effectively absorbing and blocking vibrations generated by the motor, servo noise, and micro vibrations caused by inside and outside. In addition, the drive motor fixed to the base chassis is floated via a rubber cushion for complete vibration control.We have newly adopted resin-based Corean material for the stabilizer.Although the mass of this material is small, it is excellent in vibration damping characteristics and high wheel performance that the material itself possesses.The turntable is equipped with a new non-slip sheet that accurately transmits the rotation of the spindle shaft to the disk to reduce the signal reading jitter value related to the rotation accuracy.Master clock oscillation circuit is mounted.This circuit is located on the PCB board of the digital output circuit, and the signal sent from the servo circuit is oscillated in perfect synchronization with the master clock by high-speed memory, which eliminates the jitter value of the signal caused by external interference such as the servo circuit.Wireless remote control is included."

name: TL-2X
description: "CD transport developed as an improved version of TL-2.A strong floating mechanism is adopted in which the drive motor is also floating.In the past, the drive part was fixed to the base chassis of the case, but it was changed to an independent system in which the drive part floats through a rubber cushion, and vibration and servo noise generated by the drive motor itself, as well as micro vibration transmitted to the base chassis and the floor are shut out.At the same time, the mechanism chassis has been replaced with a flexible rubber cushion instead of a floating double structure suspension. This improves the shielding effect against small vibrations and servo noise caused by internal and external sources.For the large stabilizer, we have newly adopted resin-based Corean material, which has the property of damping vibration and excellent wheel performance. For the turntable, we have newly installed a non-slip sheet that accurately transmits the rotation of the spindle to the disk. Together with the damping property of the stabilizer, we have reduced the signal reading jitter value.A high-precision master clock oscillation circuit is newly installed.This circuit is mounted on the board of the digital output circuit. The signal sent from the servo circuit is synchronized with the master clock and oscillated by high-speed memory. This eliminates the jitter component caused by external interference such as the servo circuit.The exterior uses 6 mm thick highly rigid aluminum material to absorb sound pressure of the speaker and vibration from the outside.Wireless remote control is included."

name: TL51
description: "Belt-drive CD transport with a rich digital interface.Equipped with 4 digital output terminals.In addition to the AES/EBU standard XLR, coaxial RCA, and TOS link interfaces, it is equipped with CEC Superlink, a unique signal synchronization technology that enables jitter-free high-definition digital transmission.The CEC Super Link is a unique transmission method that does not use the SPDIF code, which converts all audio signals into one continuous signal.The SPDIF uses double-phase modulation for clock encoding, which makes it impossible to separate audio signals without jitter. The CEC Superlink uses a parallel data transfer scheme, which allows each audio data stream or clock signal to be transmitted completely independently without encoding / decoding.In the Super Link operation mode, a method called Synchronized Clock Link is adopted. The master clock is generated at a position very close to the DAC stage and takes over control of the CD transport. This synchronizes the input digital audio signal with the master clock just before it arrives at the DAC stage, thus minimizing degradation of sound quality.The mechanism uses a belt drive system.In this system, the disk is clamped by a stabilizer and the spindle motor, which transmits rotation to the disk, is completely separated from the mechanical chassis by a belt drive, thereby absorbing and shielding vibration and electromagnetic noise generated by the motor itself.A center mount system is adopted, and the mechanism part is located in the center of the case, which absorbs and blocks sound pressure from the speaker and micro vibration from inside and outside.In addition, a special anti-vibration material is attached to the lower chassis of the pickup section to cut vibration.Wireless remote control is included."

name: DX71
description: "A DA converter designed by Carlos Kandyas.Digital inputs include AEX/EBU (XLR), COAX (RCA), TOS and CEC Superlink. Four inputs can be connected simultaneously and can be switched with a remote control.In principle, the DX71 is equipped with four 24-bit DACs of Defar Indian Current Bias type, which does not generate 0 cross strain.
